description: Demurrage and detention calculator — Container demurrage or detention charges. Give start (YYYY-MM-DD, discharge/availability date for demurrage or gate-out for detention) and rate (per chargeable day) or tiered rates=1-4:150,5-8:250,9+:350; optional end (pickup/return date, default today), freeDays (default 4), dayType (calendar default, or business = free time skips weekends and US federal holidays), type (demurrage or detention), currency. Returns last free day, chargeable days, total charge, per-tier breakdown, day-by-day schedule, cost if returned 1/3/7/14 days later, status and FMC billing-rule notes. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
